bias.en: Neutral · lost the averages, SAR turned bearish
bias.zh: 中性 · 跌破均线，SAR 转空

read.en: Amazon fell 4.6% on Oct 22 to $250.38, trading between $248.00 and $258.36 on 1.4 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($257.6), rising 10-day ($257.7), rising 30-day ($253.7) and falling 100-day ($251.9) averages, and above the rising 200-day ($243.3). MACD is still above its signal and zero, but the histogram is near a cross; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 22 ($265.34), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月22日下跌 4.6%，收于 $250.38，盘中区间 $248.00–258.36，成交量为 20 日均量的 1.4 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$257.6）、上行的 10 日（$257.7）、上行的 30 日（$253.7）和下行的 100 日均线（$251.9）下方，仍在上行的 200 日均线（$243.3）上方。MACD 仍在信号线及零轴上方，但柱状图接近交叉；抛物线 SAR 于 10月22日转为看空（$265.34），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The drop broke the $258 and $252–254 supports (5, 10, 30 and 100-day averages), now resistance; the close held above the $248.6 Oct 15–16 lows. Resistance is $251.9–253.7, then $257.6–258.4 (5 and 10-day, Oct 22 high) and $265.3 (Oct 20 high, SAR). Support is $248–248.6, then $243.3–244.7 (200-day, September lows). A close below $248 would open $244; a close above $258.4 would target $265.3.

s.en: Oct 15 and Oct 16 lows; Oct 22 low $248.0
